method correct_bracketing(brackets: string) returns (result: bool)
    requires brackets != null
    ensures result == (CountOpenBrackets(brackets) == CountCloseBrackets(brackets) && 
                      AllBracketsBalanced(brackets))

    // Helper function to count opening brackets
    method CountOpenBrackets(b: string) returns (count: int)
        requires b != null
        ensures count >= 0
        ensures count == |{ i: int | 0 <= i < b.Length && b[i] == '<' }|

    // Helper function to count closing brackets
    method CountCloseBrackets(b: string) returns (count: int)
        requires b != null
        ensures count >= 0
        ensures count == |{ i: int | 0 <= i < b.Length && b[i] == '>' }|

    // Helper function to check if brackets are balanced
    method AllBracketsBalanced(b: string) returns (balanced: bool)
        requires b != null
        ensures balanced == true ==> CountOpenBrackets(b) >= CountCloseBrackets(b)
        ensures balanced == false ==> CountOpenBrackets(b) < CountCloseBrackets(b)
